ops_alert: :rotating_light: INCIDENT: token-service issuing delayed tokens causing 401s and timeouts for hosted API clients in us-west-1 and us-central. Auto-alert triggered for auth-failure-rate > 1% on /v1/generate. Paging oncall.
sara_oncall: seeing spike in auth errors and increased p95 on API gateway. Gateway logs show `token fetch timeout` and retries. Example: `GET /v1/token 504`
ben_sre: checking token-db (postgres) and redis caches. Redis RTT for token-lookup spiking to 300-400ms; token-db connections show increased lock wait.
kevin_api: rate-limiter reports many requests queued waiting for token resolution, causing downstream timeouts. Rolling feature-flag: enable token-cache-bypass=false to force fallback to local JWT verification for known keys. Pushing change to gateway canary now.
prod_comm: status page created: https://status.redwood.example/incidents/1770555555 — Impact: delayed auth / increased 401/504 for hosted API in NA. Mitigation in progress.
support_desk: customers reporting auth failures on short-lived tokens from SDKs. Advising retries and pointing to status page.
ben_sre: identified root correlation — a recent token-minting job started sending heavy batched writes to token-db at 03:10 which coincided with increased index contention on `tokens(seq)`; the job is still running. Pausing job now.
sara_oncall: canary for local JWT verification applied to 2/6 gateway nodes. Those nodes show normalized latencies and successful responses. Rolling to remaining canaries.
kevin_api: after canary rollout, majority of API traffic now succeeds via local verification. Error-rate down ~80%. Continuing to monitor for edge-cases where tokens require live validation.
security: note that fallback to local verification preserves integrity for standard tokens; we are auditing exceptions where revocation checks would be missed. Will reconcile once token-db healthy.
ben_sre: paused minting job and increased token-db maintenance window to flush locks. Redis eviction pressure also relieved after TTL tuning.
prod_comm: status update: "Partial mitigation: gateway canary enabled local JWT verification; token-mint job paused; error-rate decreasing. Preparing customer advisory."
support_desk: sent interim message to impacted customers with retry guidance and link to status page. No customer data impacted.
sara_oncall: final update: token-db connection metrics and redis RTT back to baseline; gateway error-rate stable. Reverting canary flag after controlled period? ben_sre suggests keep local verification enabled for 15m as safety net while we run postmortem.
ben_sre: postmortem owner assigned: ben_sre. Action items: 1) add alerts for token-db index lock wait > 100ms for 2min, 2) add canary safety for token-mint jobs with backpressure, 3) implement preflight check for token-db index health before large batch jobs.
prod_comm: status page: "Resolved: services returned to normal; monitoring for 1h. Postmortem requested."
ops_alert: RESOLVED signal at 1770557400 — incident closed. Postmortem ticket: https://redwood.internal/pm/1770555555-postmortem
